title: Throttle init arrival_last_tick=0 suppresses a run's first arrival at tick 0-1 and taints the W4 `suppressed` metric
detail: Init/reset 0 doubles as "clicked at tick 0": a first arrival at tick 0-1 is silenced and counted in `suppressed` with no prior click — the very counter the audio_throttle golden's W4 guard relies on (suppressed >= 1).
recommended_fix: Use a sentinel (max(u64) or a has_clicked bool) so a run's first arrival always plays; reserve `suppressed` for genuine throttle bites.

title: Caption struct comment claims `text` is always a view into `buf`, but arrival captions assign a string literal
detail: The arrival path stores the static literal "packet delivered" in c.text, contradicting the stated text-is-a-buf-view invariant. Harmless today (literals are static), but any future code trusting the aliasing breaks.
recommended_fix: Fix the comment to state text is a buf view only for crisis captions, or copy the arrival string into buf to make the invariant true.

title: `draws` field comment claims it is the harness's vacuous-guard; the harness never reads it
detail: The harness vacuous-guard checks crisis_draws, arrival_draws and suppressed — never `draws`. Only the unit tests read `draws`. The comment misdescribes the mechanism (stale from a pre-W3 draft).
recommended_fix: Reword the comment ("unit-test diagnostic; the golden guards per-kind counts") or drop the field if tests move to the per-kind counters.

title: Variant draws assume pp.rng_range's upper bound is inclusive; nothing in the diff pins that convention
evidence:
+			variant: i32 = pp.rng_range(&a.cosmetic, 0, i32(CRISIS_VARIANTS) - 1)
+		testing.expectf(t, a.pending.arrival_variant >= 0 && a.pending.arrival_variant < ARRIVAL_VARIANTS,
+			"arrival variant %d out of range", a.pending.arrival_variant)
detail: If rng_range's hi is exclusive, variant slot 3 is unreachable — and the range-only test assertions plus the sim-hash golden would still pass. The boundary convention is unverifiable from the diff alone.
recommended_fix: Add a seeded-draw test asserting all three variants occur, or state rng_range's inclusive-hi contract in a comment at the call site.

title: audio_destroy unloads sounds only when device_on, but closes the audio device unconditionally
detail: When InitAudioDevice fails (the headless/CI silent-fallback path), CloseAudioDevice still runs against a device that was never opened. Harmless iff raylib no-ops internally; the guard asymmetry is suspicious from the diff alone.
recommended_fix: Move rl.CloseAudioDevice() inside the if a.device_on block, mirroring the unload guard, so teardown matches the initialized state.

title: Captions are stamped with the event tick but queried with the current app tick — a >=40-tick catch-up frame births them pre-expired
evidence:
+			set_caption(&a.caption, crisis_caption(&a.caption, cat, e), e.tick, true)
+	txt, ok := au.caption_live(&app.audio, app.tick)
+		// itself is never drained — the 4.2 tripwire). Catch-up frames deliver
+		// their ticks' cues in tick order (ODN-14). PURE (no sim access —
detail: Catch-up frames are an explicit feature ("deliver their ticks' cues in tick order"). A hitch spanning CAPTION_DWELL_TICKS (40) stages captions whose dwell ends before draw time — the a11y "every alert is captioned" contract silently breaks.
recommended_fix: Stamp captions with the consume-time tick, or clamp until_tick to render tick plus remaining dwell, so a catch-up batch's last alert keeps its on-screen dwell.
